settings.avatarHint: PNG/JPEG, at most 12KB; synced to connected devices with HELLO
settings.addrHint: If discovery fails, send a full address to the peer and let it paste it under Manual connect.
settings.rateLimitHint: KB/s, 0 = unlimited (send + receive combined, applies immediately)
settings.prehashHint: Compute whole-file SHA-256 first so the receiver can skip files it already has (reads large files twice)
settings.autoAcceptHint: Skip the confirmation dialog for every device (not recommended; trust a single device instead)
settings.singleInstanceHint: Takes effect after restart. When off, multiple instances can run (each with its own data dir and identity, for development).
settings.wanEnableHint: Takes effect after restart. Advertises public addresses and uses NAT traversal / relays (the peer must enable it too).
settings.reachHint: Publicly reachable devices automatically relay for others
settings.reachPrivate: LAN only (needs a relay or hole punching)
settings.relaysPlaceholder: One per line: /ip4/203.0.113.5/tcp/8787/p2p/12D3Koo… (no built-in public relays; use your own)
settings.groupHint: Reconnects to the relay immediately on save; other cross-network fields still need a restart. The relay must use the same -group or -group-file value.
settings.configPathEmpty: Not created yet; it will be generated on save (next to the executable by default)
settings.proxyAlert: IPv4 TCP/UDP. Split: only matching CIDRs/domains go through the tunnel, everything else stays direct (for listed domains, DNS is hijacked by the local fake-IP so they do use the tunnel). Global: all traffic including DNS goes through the relay exit, and names are resolved on the exit. One entry per line. Needs administrator rights and a restart. The relay must run with -exit and its allowlist must contain this PeerID.
settings.proxyDisabledHint: Enable the proxy and restart to take effect
settings.proxySocksHint: No admin rights needed: point your browser or system proxy here to use the relay (names are resolved on the exit)
settings.proxyRoutesPlaceholder:
One IPv4 CIDR per line (spaces/commas also work), e.g.
93.184.216.0/24
142.250.0.0/15
settings.proxyDomainsPlaceholder:
One domain per line (subdomains included; spaces/commas also work), e.g.
google.com
youtube.com
settings.proxyTokenPlaceholder: Token configured with -exit-token; leave empty to send none
settings.proxyIPv6Hint: Experimental: adds an IPv6 stack and AAAA resolving to the TUN; falls back to IPv4 if init fails
settings.socksEnableHint: When disabled, port 20300 is not opened (restart to apply); the fields below only apply when enabled
settings.socksNoAuthWarn: No credentials set: loopback only and no auth, any local process can use it.
settings.socksAuthHint: When set, RFC1929 username/password auth is required
settings.socksListenPlaceholder: Empty = 127.0.0.1:20300; defaults to 0.0.0.0:20300 when an allow list is set
settings.socksAllowPlaceholder: One CIDR per line, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24; empty = loopback only
